messages:
alex.ng: hey team — hit a snag on day 2. can't finish Okta setup; keeps looping back to the activation page after I click the email link.
onboard-bot: Welcome alex.ng! If you're seeing an activation loop, try opening the Okta link in an incognito window and disable any adblockers.
alex.ng: tried incognito + different browser, same loop. also the Okta page asks me to enroll MFA but when I try to add a security key (YubiKey) it times out.
it-support: hey alex — can you paste the exact error text? Also which OS/browser are you on?
alex.ng: Chrome on Ubuntu 22.04. error toast says "Failed to register security key. Try again." no extra details.
it-support: ok. two quick checks: 1) do you have libu2f-host / libu2f-udev installed? 2) Can you try using a phone auth app (Okta Verify) to get you past initial enrollment?
alex.ng: i don't think libu2f is installed. i can try Okta Verify on my phone but i'd like to register the security key for later.
karina.liu: fwiw our onboarding doc mentions a udev rule for Linux USB tokens — @it-support can you share it?
it-support: sure. attaching snippet:

```
# udev rule for YubiKey (example)
SUBSYSTEM=="usb", ATTR{idVendor}=="1050", MODE="0666"
```

Also run: sudo apt install libu2f-udev
and then replug the key.

If that still fails we'll temporarily enroll you with Okta Verify and escalate to infra to adjust the SCIM sync.
sabrina: alex, to unblock Google Drive access we need you in the "Employees" GSuite group — I don't see your account in there yet.
alex.ng: thanks — i'm missing Drive access too. clicking drive gives 403.
it-support: alex — I added you to a temporary group and forced a SCIM sync. try the Okta activation link again in incognito, enroll Okta Verify when prompted, then try Drive.
alex.ng: ok got the Okta Verify QR. enrolled. I can now access Slack but Drive still 403.
sabrina: give me 5 — pushing the group membership via admin console.
sabrina: done. refresh and try Drive again.
alex.ng: Drive works now. also replugged YubiKey after libu2f install and registration succeeded. Thanks everyone :tada: 
it-support: merging this into onboarding notes — will add a Linux YubiKey checklist and a step to force SCIM on new hires to avoid delay. tagging @onboard-bot to include in runbook.
onboard-bot: Added "Linux YubiKey checklist" to /handbook/onboarding and scheduled a reminder for infra to review SCIM sync cadence.
karina.liu: awesome, congrats alex — welcome aboard :raised_hands: 
alex.ng: thanks all! appreciate the quick help.
